tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search LUXAIRY's European fashion catalogue: ranked products with the best offer, sizes in stock, shipping and a shop link. Pass the shopper's country and size; ships_to adds shipping. Without a query, filters browse a brand or category. Up to 100 results via offset; if nothing matches, the reply na

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get every offer LUXAIRY has for one product, from all its shops: price, sizes in stock, shipping and links. Use after search_products with its `product_id` to compare shops or check a size; not for finding products. With `size` or `ships_to`, shops without them are left out; none left gives no offer

tools.name: find_biggest_discount
tools.description: For deal questions (sales, Black Friday): only products on sale and in stock, the largest discount first, with min_discount as a floor, which search_products lacks. The discount is off the shop's previous lowest price when it gives one, else its regular price. Narrow by query, category, brand, gende

tools.name: find_similar_products
tools.description: Find products like one product: same category and gender, close in price, same colours and materials first. Use after search_products or get_product for "like this", "but cheaper" (cheaper), "another brand" (other_brands) or "in my size" (sizes); to search by words use search_products. Links may ear

tools.name: list_filter_values
tools.description: List the valid values of a small search filter: colours (with products and typical EUR price range), genders, size systems or sorts. Use it to spell search_products' `colours`, `gender` or `sort` exactly. For brands use list_brands, for categories list_categories; returns no products. No key; fair-u

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands LUXAIRY carries, most products first, each with its products, typical EUR price range and main categories. Use it to tell whether LUXAIRY has a brand and at what prices, or to spell search_products' `brands` (the name works as the filter). Narrow with query or category. To browse a b

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List LUXAIRY's category tree (paths such as apparel>clothing>outerwear) with products and typical EUR price range per category; a category counts its subcategories.
